IOS_A_EDITORIAL_ATLAS.strengths: Flawless Apple HIG adherence; large title 'Odisha' collapses to inline navigation title; clean grouped card list; subtle sandstone hairline accents; SF Pro typography with tabular numbers.
IOS_A_EDITORIAL_ATLAS.weaknesses: Initial prompt suggested generic iOS search bar that crowded the navigation bar.
IOS_A_EDITORIAL_ATLAS.generic_template_symptoms: Avoided standard Airbnb-style bottom navigation and floating pills.
IOS_A_EDITORIAL_ATLAS.truth_contract_issues: None; truth badges render cleanly as vibrant capsule pills (.tint(.green), .tint(.orange)).
IOS_A_EDITORIAL_ATLAS.accessibility_issues: Full Dynamic Type scaling up to AX5; VoiceOver reads cards as unified accessibility elements.
IOS_A_EDITORIAL_ATLAS.motion_feasibility: Native NavigationStack push with interactive swipe-to-pop; 60/120fps fluid.
IOS_A_EDITORIAL_ATLAS.device_feasibility: EXCELLENT across iPhone 11 to iPhone 16 Pro.

IOS_A_EDITORIAL_ATLAS.strengths: Edge-to-edge verified photography with subtle gradient overlay; collapsible editorial sections; live weather card using SF Symbols (sun.max.fill, cloud.sun.fill); native Apple Maps / Google Maps handoff sheet.
IOS_A_EDITORIAL_ATLAS.weaknesses: Need to ensure Odia text uses proper font cascade (Kohinoor Odia) without vertical clipping.
IOS_A_EDITORIAL_ATLAS.generic_template_symptoms: Zero fake star reviews or user rating widgets.
IOS_A_EDITORIAL_ATLAS.truth_contract_issues: Provenance and opening hours clearly attributed to verified sources.
IOS_A_EDITORIAL_ATLAS.accessibility_issues: Passed; high contrast labels and full VoiceOver heading hierarchy.
IOS_A_EDITORIAL_ATLAS.motion_feasibility: Native SwiftUI scroll bounce; no custom renderers.

IOS_A_EDITORIAL_ATLAS.strengths: First-party SwiftUI.Map integration; custom MapMarker annotations; native presentationDetents (.fraction(0.25), .fraction(0.6), .large) for place preview sheet; immediate external routing trigger.
IOS_A_EDITORIAL_ATLAS.weaknesses: Need to prevent bottom sheet grabber from conflicting with swipe-up home indicator.
IOS_A_EDITORIAL_ATLAS.generic_template_symptoms: None; feels like Apple Maps with a cultural curation layer.
IOS_A_EDITORIAL_ATLAS.truth_contract_issues: Candidate stops rendered with dashed amber circles; verified stops have solid emerald pins.
IOS_A_EDITORIAL_ATLAS.accessibility_issues: Accessible list view easily accessible via navigation bar trailing button.
IOS_A_EDITORIAL_ATLAS.motion_feasibility: Native sheet spring physics (interactiveSpring); buttery smooth.

IOS_A_EDITORIAL_ATLAS.strengths: Native SwiftUI Form / Section structure; Steppers for days and pace; segmented picker for transit preference; discrete AI assistant text box for natural language refinement.
IOS_A_EDITORIAL_ATLAS.weaknesses: Form can look slightly utilitarian without editorial hero photography.
IOS_A_EDITORIAL_ATLAS.generic_template_symptoms: Zero neon AI gradients or conversational chatbot bubbles.
IOS_A_EDITORIAL_ATLAS.truth_contract_issues: Clear notice that trip schedules are solved deterministically from verified transit databases.
IOS_A_EDITORIAL_ATLAS.accessibility_issues: Native iOS form components have built-in accessibility traits.

IOS_A_EDITORIAL_ATLAS.strengths: Sectioned List by day; transit legs clearly demarcated with bus glyph and route numbers; walking distances shown as FirstMileEngine pills; 'Save Itinerary' button in navigation toolbar.
IOS_A_EDITORIAL_ATLAS.weaknesses: Large itineraries with > 5 days require collapsible day disclosure groups.
IOS_A_EDITORIAL_ATLAS.truth_contract_issues: Fares explicitly marked null; departure times labeled [◷ Scheduled · HH:MM IST].
IOS_A_EDITORIAL_ATLAS.accessibility_issues: Clear section headers and tabular departure times.

IOS_A_EDITORIAL_ATLAS.strengths: Prominent next-stop card with distance and walking pill; emergency call button (telephony intent) directly in navigation bar; manual 'Mark Visited' advances milestone; 100% offline operable from SwiftData.
IOS_A_EDITORIAL_ATLAS.weaknesses: Ensure phone dialer prompt confirmation is clear before initiating emergency calls.
IOS_A_EDITORIAL_ATLAS.truth_contract_issues: Only verified phone numbers and canonical coordinates used.
IOS_A_EDITORIAL_ATLAS.accessibility_issues: High-contrast action buttons; VoiceOver announces active stop prominently.

IOS_A_EDITORIAL_ATLAS.strengths: Native List displaying all 154 routes with searchable corridor filter; stop detail sheet shows scheduled departures, official operator citation (CRUT), and locality boundary chips.
IOS_A_EDITORIAL_ATLAS.weaknesses: Timetable rows need sufficient vertical spacing when Dynamic Type is scaled.
IOS_A_EDITORIAL_ATLAS.generic_template_symptoms: Zero fake live bus tracking or estimated arrival minutes countdown.
IOS_A_EDITORIAL_ATLAS.accessibility_issues: Monospace digits for hours and minutes.

IOS_A_EDITORIAL_ATLAS.strengths: Inset grouped list; storage breakdown bar; instant English/Odia language picker; Privacy & Terms links.
IOS_A_EDITORIAL_ATLAS.weaknesses: Storage bar needs clear legend between data bytes and photo cache.
IOS_A_EDITORIAL_ATLAS.generic_template_symptoms: Zero social login pressure or gamified points.
IOS_A_EDITORIAL_ATLAS.truth_contract_issues: Clear display of on-device vs synced trip status.

IOS_B_SPATIAL_JOURNEY.strengths: Full-screen MapKit with floating cards; high spatial awareness; smooth camera transitions between districts.
IOS_B_SPATIAL_JOURNEY.weaknesses: Less space for editorial essays; cards can obscure map points of interest.
IOS_B_SPATIAL_JOURNEY.generic_template_symptoms: Floating search bar feels a bit like Google Maps default.
IOS_B_SPATIAL_JOURNEY.accessibility_issues: VoiceOver needs an explicit accessible list button since spatial panning is difficult for blind users.
IOS_B_SPATIAL_JOURNEY.motion_feasibility: Continuous map rendering requires battery awareness.

IOS_B_SPATIAL_JOURNEY.strengths: Drawer slides up to 85% height while map remains visible in the background.
IOS_B_SPATIAL_JOURNEY.weaknesses: Map behind sheet draws GPU power even when mostly covered.
IOS_B_SPATIAL_JOURNEY.accessibility_issues: Focus must trap within the sheet when expanded.

IOS_B_SPATIAL_JOURNEY.strengths: Superb spatial interaction; camera centers immediately; haptic feedback on pin selection.
IOS_B_SPATIAL_JOURNEY.weaknesses: Dense city areas (Old Town Bhubaneswar) can get visually crowded.

IOS_B_SPATIAL_JOURNEY.strengths: Travelers select destinations by lassoing or tapping directly on the map canvas.
IOS_B_SPATIAL_JOURNEY.weaknesses: Lassoing on mobile screen is error-prone while walking or riding.
IOS_B_SPATIAL_JOURNEY.generic_template_symptoms: Novelty interaction that violates standard iOS simplicity.
IOS_B_SPATIAL_JOURNEY.truth_contract_issues: Hard to communicate deterministic transit constraints purely through spatial gestures.
IOS_B_SPATIAL_JOURNEY.accessibility_issues: Fails standard VoiceOver accessibility without complete form fallback.

IOS_B_SPATIAL_JOURNEY.strengths: Route polyline drawn dynamically on the map as traveler swipes through day cards.
IOS_B_SPATIAL_JOURNEY.weaknesses: If route covers statewide distances (Puri to Sambalpur), map zooms out too far to see details.

IOS_B_SPATIAL_JOURNEY.strengths: Navigation-style tracking; live distance to next milestone; map camera tracks user location.
IOS_B_SPATIAL_JOURNEY.weaknesses: High battery drain from continuous GPS + MapKit rendering.
IOS_B_SPATIAL_JOURNEY.generic_template_symptoms: Looks like an in-car turn-by-turn navigation app rather than a cultural guide.
IOS_B_SPATIAL_JOURNEY.truth_contract_issues: Risks giving traveler the impression of real-time turn-by-turn routing instead of external handoff.

IOS_B_SPATIAL_JOURNEY.strengths: Complete bus route polyline rendered on map with bus stop nodes.
IOS_B_SPATIAL_JOURNEY.weaknesses: 154 routes simultaneously would cause severe visual clutter; requires aggressive corridor filtering.

IOS_B_SPATIAL_JOURNEY.strengths: Saved destinations plotted as gold star pins on the map.
IOS_B_SPATIAL_JOURNEY.weaknesses: Hard to browse 50+ saved bookmarks spatially; list view is much faster.

IOS_C_GLASS_HERITAGE.strengths: Deep visual luxury; translucent glass navigation bar and glass tab bar; specular highlights; progressive enhancement using native .ultraThinMaterial and real Liquid Glass on iOS 26+.
IOS_C_GLASS_HERITAGE.weaknesses: Over-reliance on glass blur can reduce text contrast in direct outdoor sun.
IOS_C_GLASS_HERITAGE.generic_template_symptoms: Temptation to add neon reflections or synthetic glass shine.
IOS_C_GLASS_HERITAGE.truth_contract_issues: Truth badges look gorgeous but must maintain opaque high-contrast borders.
IOS_C_GLASS_HERITAGE.accessibility_issues: Must strictly support 'Reduce Transparency' system setting (reverting to solid opaque surfaces).
IOS_C_GLASS_HERITAGE.motion_feasibility: Real-time blur shader passes on older iPhones can cause frame hitches.
IOS_C_GLASS_HERITAGE.device_feasibility: RISKY on iPhone 11; smooth on iPhone 15 Pro+.

IOS_C_GLASS_HERITAGE.strengths: Frosted glass bottom sheet sliding over photography; rich tactile feel.
IOS_C_GLASS_HERITAGE.weaknesses: Long cultural essays are tiring to read over blurred image backgrounds.

IOS_C_GLASS_HERITAGE.strengths: Floating glass search capsule and glass preview sheet over MapKit.
IOS_C_GLASS_HERITAGE.weaknesses: Too many translucent layers over the map can cause visual mush.
IOS_C_GLASS_HERITAGE.truth_contract_issues: Dashed candidate rings look indistinct through frosted glass.

IOS_C_GLASS_HERITAGE.strengths: Glass cards with tactile slider controls.
IOS_C_GLASS_HERITAGE.weaknesses: Form inputs feel less crisp than standard iOS grouped tables.

IOS_C_GLASS_HERITAGE.strengths: Translucent milestone cards with tinted glass status badges.
IOS_C_GLASS_HERITAGE.weaknesses: Dense timetable data is hard to scan across translucent backgrounds.
IOS_C_GLASS_HERITAGE.generic_template_symptoms: Visual styling gets in the way of utility.
IOS_C_GLASS_HERITAGE.truth_contract_issues: Fares and timetables must be legible.

IOS_C_GLASS_HERITAGE.weaknesses: Extremely difficult to read while walking under coastal Odisha mid-day sun.
IOS_C_GLASS_HERITAGE.generic_template_symptoms: HUD styling inappropriate for heritage walking.
IOS_C_GLASS_HERITAGE.truth_contract_issues: Emergency contacts must not be blurred.

IOS_C_GLASS_HERITAGE.weaknesses: Thin frosted dividers lack sufficient contrast in transit environments.
Standard iOS grouped table is simpler and faster.

summary: All 24 iOS surface concepts evaluated against traveler jobs, truth contracts, Apple HIG, accessibility, and device performance.
